children: This is the history subpage for the Jester. It contains every revision of the tower's statistics.
Burn damage is 30% of base damage.
Total Elapsed Damage is calculated as Burn Damage × (Burn Time ÷ Burn Tick).
DPS assumes only one enemy is hit and that only one type of bomb is used.
Damage is 20% of the regular damage.
Poison damage is 30% of base damage.
DPS assumes only one enemy is hit from one poisonous puddle and that only one type of bomb is used.
Damage is 0% of the regular damage.
